caption: The drawing features a dense and intricate composition primarily filled with large, blooming flowers, leafy foliage, and a pair of birds. The flowers are colored in shades of pink, red, and coral, with central details drawn in white and light tones, while the leaves are predominantly dark green with some purple and muted brown accents. The birds, situated centrally, have long tail feathers and are marked with a combination of red, brown, and cream hues. The background includes swirling, vine-like patterns in dark and light brown shades that further fill the space between the floral and avian elements. The overall drawing sits within a rectangular frame on a plain, off-white background.
title: Printed Cotton
